function processData() {
    // Start of function
    let x = 10;
    let y = 20;

function handleError() {
    // This function has problems
    throw new Error("Something went wrong");
    // unreachable code

class UserService {
    constructor() {
        this.users = [];
    }

    addUser(user) {
        this.users.push(user);
    }

    getUser(id) {
        return this.users.find(u => u.id === id);
    }
}
